::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Jany 3d 1877  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Bodleian Library, Oxford:  MS. Autogr. d.23 f116
:::

Dear Madam

Let me thank you very heartily for your kind gift of your Fathers photograph which I shall value very much 

Yours truly
C M Yonge
